summary: @sl007 Zoom, which we we used to film #IndieWeb, has decent speech to text, but best so far been new Android recorder (you have to side load apk for now), works locally on device & lowest error rate I have seen. Still need 2-3x video length to clean up.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @sl007 Zoom, which we we used to film #IndieWeb, has decent speech to text, but best so far been new Android recorder (you have to side load apk for now), works locally on device & lowest error rate I have seen. Still need 2-3x video length to clean up.
